articles.title: This Teen's Plant-Based Plastic Could Help Clean Up Microplastics
articles.summary: Arya Satheesh, 18, developed Eco Purge, a bioplastic that decomposes while breaking down microplastics. Her invention earned her the European regional title at The Earth Prize and $12,500.

articles.title: Naruto's New Anime Finally Resurfaces — Big Announcement Set for NYCC
articles.summary: After a three-year wait, Naruto fans will finally get news about the new anime at New York Comic Con on Oct. 10. The panel, 'Naruto: What's Next,' promises the latest on the limited series.

articles.title: WALL-E vs. Reality: Why Space AI Still Needs a Human Copilot
articles.summary: In WALL-E, an AI named AUTO runs a whole starship. Real space AI is way more limited — it hallucinates and needs humans watching. NASA uses it for Mars rovers and satellites, but full robot independence is still far off.
